{{Top}}
A '''metric ton''' was a unit used to measure large quantities of mass, such as the cargo capacity of [[spaceships]]. '''Gigatons''', '''kilotons''', and '''megatons'''<ref name="Goroth">''[[Goroth: Slave of the Empire]]''</ref> were terms for larger numbers of metric tons, and were often used to describe the destructive power of weapons.

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The [[roleplaying game]]s by [[West End Games]] ([[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game|D6]]) and [[Wizards of the Coast]] ([[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|d20]] & [[Saga Edition|Saga]]) included measurements in metric tons for the cargo capacity of large vehicles such as [[Tramp freighter/Legends|tramp freighters]].
